name: Succubus Trick: Grown Up Problem
source:
After moving back to his childhood town, our protagonist, Eric, has many things he needs to get reacquainted with again. School is hard, but there is something "harder" for Eric after his mysterious encounter with a lady he helped out one night. Eventually, he will receive much help from people around him for his "grown-up" problem.

[From [url=https://apieceoftissue.itch.io/grown-up-problem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
搬回童年生活过的小镇后，主人公埃里克有许多事情需要重新适应。上学已经够难了，可某个夜晚，他帮助了一位女士，并与她有了一场神秘的邂逅，此后又遇到了更“难”的问题。最终，周围的人会为他这个“长大成人”的烦恼提供许多帮助。

（摘自[url=https://apieceoftissue.itch.io/grown-up-problem]itch.io[/url]）
